budget.reason: ref_tile: boundary budget 0.2 T applied in-run

structural_change: HBM-SU3 10-17 qcore r5 (coordinator 0dc): 66 clock roots (64 per-bank clk_rf + ctl + red; codex hbm_qcore_s_pinrung_r2) -> 10 regional roots: one per RF sector of 8 banks (~9.6k sinks each), clk_ctl, clk_red. Raw RF/relay/COLL command capture at the pins per root (PHYS_RF_INGRESS), so ingress -> decode -> bank stays inside one root; only the read mux -> rf_bword/rf_dsec/operand and the conflict -> fault cross roots. Same edges (commit n+1, read n+3, scalar E+11); write-conflict FAULT +1 edge (status). Reducer SRAMs on the 43.2 lattice at the pin-free S side; die faces kept (W slice, E channel, N clocks) with full-face pin spread. Re-home: H-DIE-R7b/R8b grants put sucore_<q> beside its pgslices (x~9000 between su_<q>1 and su_<q>2).
